request.raw_text: Let's make this part symmetric. There is a step on one of the sides of the whistle. Move the protruding surface so that it is level with the surface next to it. Delete all chamfers and radii and new ones following rules: Horizontal edges in the area where the narrow and bigger part of the whistle meet have a radius R=20mm. Other edges have R=5mm applied to them

areas_to_change.action: Move the offset protruding side surface until it is coplanar with the adjacent surface.
areas_to_change.reference_geometry: The unilateral step and protruding surface on one side of the whistle body.
areas_to_change.location: At the side of the model near the transition between the enlarged rounded portion and the narrow elongated portion.
areas_to_change.description: Eliminate the visible side step by shifting the protruding face to the plane of its neighboring face, producing a symmetric exterior about the whistle's longitudinal center plane.

areas_to_change.action: Delete all existing chamfer and radius features.
areas_to_change.reference_geometry: All currently chamfered or rounded exterior and feature edges.
areas_to_change.location: Throughout the whistle model, including the enlarged body, narrow body, end faces, and their junction.
areas_to_change.description: Remove the current edge treatments before constructing the replacement fillet scheme.

areas_to_change.reference_geometry: Horizontal edges in the junction area between the narrow and enlarged portions.
areas_to_change.location: The transition where the narrow elongated body meets the larger rounded body.
areas_to_change.description: Create large 20 mm fillets on the horizontal transition edges to blend the narrow and enlarged portions smoothly.

areas_to_change.reference_geometry: All remaining edges not assigned the R=20mm transition treatment.
areas_to_change.location: Across the remainder of the part.
areas_to_change.description: Create uniform 5 mm edge radii on all other geometrically eligible edges after removal of the original chamfers and radii.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: The overall longitudinal size and basic narrow-to-enlarged whistle layout.
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Retain the principal dimensions and topology except for the side-step correction and specified edge-treatment replacement.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: The circular opening visible on the end face of the narrow portion.
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve its location, axis, diameter, and passage geometry unless its entrance edge is included in the requested R=5mm treatment.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: The rectangular opening or recess visible on the lower/side face.
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve its position, size, depth, and functional connectivity; only alter its edges if the all-other-edges R=5mm rule is intended to include internal feature edges.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Planar functional faces and the internal whistle airflow geometry.
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Do not move or reshape these features except for the explicitly identified protruding exterior surface.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: The larger body and narrow stem centerlines.
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Keep them aligned while making the exterior side geometry symmetric.

predicted_final_outcome.geometry: A laterally symmetric whistle body with the unilateral side step removed, R20 blends at the horizontal narrow-to-large-body transition edges, and R5 fillets replacing the remaining original chamfers and radii.
predicted_final_outcome.function: The whistle's openings and airflow-related features remain functionally unchanged while the exterior becomes symmetric and consistently rounded.
predicted_final_outcome.behavior: The part should retain its original operating behavior, with smoother transitions at the body junction and reduced sharpness on other edges.

ambiguities.description: The request does not explicitly identify the symmetry plane or the exact protruding face to move.
candidate_interpretations: Use the longitudinal center plane and move the offset side face inward until it is flush with the adjacent narrow-body side face.
Move the neighboring recessed face outward to match the protruding face.
Make the opposite side a mirror of the currently protruding side.

ambiguities.description: The meaning of horizontal edges depends on the model coordinate system or selected drawing view.
candidate_interpretations: Edges parallel to the whistle's longitudinal axis at the narrow-to-large-body junction.
Edges appearing horizontal in the supplied side views.
Edges lying in a global horizontal plane at that junction.

ambiguities.description: Applying R=5mm to all other edges may include internal openings and short edges where that radius is infeasible.
candidate_interpretations: Apply R5 only to eligible exterior edges.
Apply R5 to both exterior and internal opening edges wherever geometrically possible.
Apply R5 to every remaining edge, reducing the radius locally only where necessary.

ambiguities.description: Deleting all existing radii could refer either to modeled edge fillets only or also to the large rounded silhouette that defines the enlarged body.
candidate_interpretations: Delete only explicit fillet and chamfer features, then rebuild them using R20 and R5.
Remove every rounded boundary, including the large body profile, and replace all resulting edges according to the new radius rules.
